acceptanceCriteria: A repeated top-level `schema` member in a provider record is refused with a strict-decode reason in `impact` and `affected`, covered by a test.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent reviews of the V1 wave-1/wave-2 pull requests (#74-#82). Review of PR #76 (V1-0027): the Core `impact` decoder in cmd/corvint does not reject a provider record whose `schema` member repeats; the kit conformance runner does. Corvint invariant 1 wants one strict decode.

completion.reason: Fixed by beamfall/corvint#186, merged to main as a0632411.

title: cmd/corvint: `impact` accepts a provider record with a repeated `schema` member (last wins)
